data_maturity_caveat: Calibrated PROVISIONAL NISAR data covers June 18 to Nov 9, 2026 (~5 months, Kharif-II / Aman monsoon season). Dry-season Boro rice (Nov–May) is outside this calibrated window; pre-calibration BETA scenes (Oct 2025–Jan 2026) exist on western tracks but are not mixed here due to calibration caveats. All cluster labels are unsupervised hypotheses without field surveys.

clusters.name: Early Transplanted Aman Paddy (June Inundation -> Sept Peak)
clusters.hypothesis: Hypothesis (no field-survey ground truth): Cluster 1 (266.6 km² of ESA WorldCover cropland) reaches its lowest HV backscatter (-16.89 dB) on 2026-07-24 during field inundation/transplanting, and peaks at -14.25 dB on 2026-10-28 (ΔHV = +2.64 dB from canopy volume scattering).
